name: Runemaster audit #2743: Freezing Codex reshapes Ice Rune's cooldown, range and cost
contract: Freezing Codex 705577: 'Reduces the cooldown of Ice Rune by $/1000;s1 sec and increases the mana cost by
$s3%, but reduces its range by $s2 yds.' Re-verified in Spell.dbc: three SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER /
SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effects share EffectSpellClassMask mask0 2 on family 38: Effect0 MiscValue 11 =
SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, EffectBasePoints0 -20001 with DieSides 1 = -20000ms; Effect1 MiscValue 5 = SPELLMOD_RANGE,
EffectBasePoints1 -11 with DieSides 1 = -10; Effect2 MiscValue 14 = SPELLMOD_COST, EffectBasePoints2 49 with
DieSides 1 = +50%. Ice Rune 524930 carries SpellFamilyName 38, SpellFamilyFlags[0] 16777218 (0x1000002),
which includes bit1 (mask 2) - a confirmed match; its own RecoveryTime is 60000ms, ManaCostPercentage 12,
RangeIndex 3. All three are the native AzerothCore spellmod system; no occurrence of 705577 exists in
src/server/coa/. Expected: with the talent, Ice Rune's cooldown modifier drops from a 60000ms base to
40000ms, its cost modifier on a 100 base rises by 50 points, its range modifier on a 0 base drops by 10;

steps.label: SETUP: Ice Rune cooldown modifier starts at 60000ms
CONTRACT: Ice Rune cooldown drops to 40000ms
CONTRACT: Ice Rune mana cost modifier rises 50 points
CONTRACT: Ice Rune range modifier drops by 10
